name: OneTrust AI Governance
pros: Privacy and AI risk in one evidence store
files: AI system records, risk assessments, and policy documentation.
value: For organizations already running OneTrust for privacy, this adds AI inventory, risk assessments, and regulatory mapping as an extension of the same platform. Avoids a second governance data silo.
engine: Governance platform. Not an AI model. Extends OneTrust's existing workflow engine.

pricing.model: Module licence on top of OneTrust
pricing.includes: AI inventory, risk workflows, regulatory mapping

quality: Excellent integration with existing OneTrust privacy workflows. Less standalone depth than dedicated AI governance tools.
tagline: AI governance as an extension of OneTrust's established privacy and risk platform.
use_cases: AI inventory and risk classification alongside existing privacy asset inventory
EU AI Act readiness assessment inside the platform already used for GDPR
Centralising AI and privacy risk evidence in one tool for audit
governance_note: The practical case is consolidation: an organization already maintaining GDPR data asset inventories in OneTrust can attach AI system inventories to the same platform without a second tool, vendor, and evidence silo. The cross-over between AI risk and privacy risk is significant enough that this consolidation is often the right decision for the first year of an AI governance program.
training_optout: Governance metadata platform. Not a model host.
